an4.108:1.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me balivaddūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.108:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo sakagavacaṇḍo hoti no paragavacaṇḍo?
an4.108:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sakaparisaṃ ubbejetā no paraparisaṃ.
an4.108:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sakagavacaṇḍo hoti no paragavacaṇḍo,
an4.108:2.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave balivaddo sakagavacaṇḍo no paragavacaṇḍo,
an4.108:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo paragavacaṇḍo hoti no sakagavacaṇḍo?
an4.108:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacca puggalo paraparisaṃ ubbejetā hoti no sakaparisaṃ.
an4.108:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo sakagavacaṇḍo ca hoti paragavacaṇḍo ca?
an4.108:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sakaparisañ ca ubbejetā hoti paraparisañ ca.
an4.108:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' eva sakagavacaṇḍo hoti na paragavacaṇḍo?
an4.108:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo n' eva sakaparisaṃ ubbejetā hoti no paraparisaṃ.
an4.108:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo n' eva sakagavacaṇḍo hoti no paragavacaṇḍo,
an4.108:5.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave balivaddo n' eva sakagavacaṇḍo hoti no paragavacaṇḍo,
an4.108:5.6: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro balivaddūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamāna lokasmin ti. 109. 1.
